layout.wedges: 5 contiguous 200-node arcs, rank-matched by old radius (progression kept)

rules.points: 1 passive point per level starting at level 2 (99 total at level 100); +3 bonus points per act boss first-kill per difficulty (max +60). A build allocates ~100-160 of 1000 nodes: specialization is the point.
rules.allocation: node allocatable iff adjacent to an allocated node; start pre-allocated; class does NOT lock branches - any class may path anywhere, travel cost is the balance
rules.deallocation: must keep allocated subgraph connected (BFS from start)
rules.keystones: require character level >= 30; each keystone has exactly one edge (gated behind a notable)
rules.stat_conventions: stats ending in _inc_pct go to the additive 'increased' bucket; _flat are flat adds; keystone 'modifiers' use ops add/more/convert/scale/set/flag/on_event per master brief engine_directives

meta.edges_rewired: uniform disk relayout + global MST/kNN rewire (star spiral with node overlaps replaced)

nodes.name: Avatar of Fire
nodes.description: 50% of Physical, Cold and Lightning Damage converted to Fire. Deal no non-Fire Damage.

nodes.name: Blood Magic
nodes.description: Spend Life instead of Mana. Maximum Mana becomes 0.

nodes.name: Chaos Inoculation
nodes.description: Maximum Life becomes 1. Immune to Chaos Damage.

nodes.name: Elemental Overload
nodes.description: 40% more Elemental Damage if you dealt a Crit recently. Crits deal no extra damage.

nodes.name: House Rules
nodes.description: Gambling costs 20% less Gold. Base Unique chance from gambling is halved (pity unchanged).

nodes.name: Loaded Dice
nodes.description: Every 10th Gamble is at least Rare. Gambled Rares upgrade to Unique with chance equal to your Item Rarity bonus / 2 (%).

nodes.name: Martyrdom
nodes.description: On death, explode for 500% of Maximum Life as Fire Damage. Respawn takes 2x longer.

nodes.name: Pain Attunement
nodes.description: 30% more Spell Damage while on Low Life.

nodes.name: Point Blank
nodes.description: 30% more Projectile Damage to enemies within 80 units; 30% less beyond 160.

nodes.name: Resolute Technique
nodes.description: Your hits can't be evaded. Never deal Critical Strikes.

nodes.name: The Rich Get Richer
nodes.description: +1% Critical Strike Multiplier per 1000 Gold held (max +50%). Items sell for 25% less.

nodes.name: Scrapper's Creed
nodes.description: Duplicate Uniques are auto-salvaged into +0.5% permanent Item Rarity each (stacks infinitely).

nodes.name: Singularity of Want
nodes.description: Gamble Hard Pity is 60 instead of 80. Soft Pity no longer applies.

nodes.name: Vaal Pact
nodes.description: Life Leech applies instantly. No Life Regeneration.

nodes.name: Zealot's Oath
nodes.description: Life Regeneration is doubled, but Healing skills heal 50% less.

nodes.name: The Exile
nodes.description: Washed ashore with nothing. Everything grows from here.
